_comment: Design-reconstruction thresholds for canonical/ollama-sdk. Reference shape (main): dump part downloading the release tarball with adopt-info/VERSION wiring, a services dump part carrying ollama.service, gpu plug, mount plug for the models directory, tunnel slot at 11434, setup-project installing + enabling the systemd user unit, check-health polling via set-health waiting, renovate github-releases datasource with extractVersionTemplate, four thin CI workflows.
